OUTPUT.description: Folder of problems.json, proposal.json and check.json when --out is not given.

OBSERVER_INFERENCE_URL.description: Base URL of an OpenAI-compatible gateway for propose, like http://localhost:4000/v1. Required for propose.

OBSERVER_INFERENCE_KEY.description: Sent to the gateway as a bearer token, when set.

OBSERVER_FORGE_URL.description: Base URL of the forge API. Default: https://api.github.com for github.com, <origin>/api/v1 for Forgejo.

OBSERVER_FORGE_TOKEN.description: Token that may push a branch and open a pull request (propose) or read and comment on one (check). Sent to the forge API and to Git, never written to a file.
